dim1.label: storey_count
dim1.description: 2 storeys clearly visible — horizontal mid-band dividing GF and UF
dim1.pass_criteria: Exactly 2 visible floor levels with distinct fenestration on each

dim2.label: roof_form_gable_front
dim2.description: Gable roof with triangular form visible on front face, 45% slope (~24 degrees). Ridge runs parallel to depth axis (perpendicular to street). Gable triangle 6.1m wide × ~1.4m tall.
dim2.pass_criteria: Triangular gable peak visible at top of front face; pitch appears moderate-to-shallow (not steep like 45-deg; actual ~24-deg)

dim3.label: fenestration_3bay
dim3.description: 3-bay front facade: 3 equal bays of ~2032mm each = 6096mm total width. GF has 2 rectangular windows (~880×915mm) + 1 door; UF has 2-3 rectangular windows. Openings are small and nearly square.
dim3.pass_criteria: 3 distinct vertical bays visible; GF has 2 windows + 1 door; UF has 2-3 windows; window openings are small and rectangular
dim3.estimated_note: Full-unit UF window count estimated — full-unit elevation not separately confirmed in DWG vs initial-delivery elevation

dim4.label: massing_proportions
dim4.description: Nearly square front aspect ratio (6.1m wide × 6.25m tall, ratio ~1:1.02). Simple rectilinear box massing. No projecting elements. Clean rectangular silhouette.
dim4.pass_criteria: Front facade is nearly square (height ≈ width); simple flat-wall box; no balconies, bay windows, or decorative elements

dim5.label: cladding_material
dim5.description: Corrugated metal cladding or simple rectilinear walls. Utilitarian finish consistent with social housing.
dim5.pass_criteria: Visible texture suggesting corrugated metal or horizontal siding; OR smooth walls with no visible ornamentation
